title: Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons
summary: The Non-Proliferation Treaty was opened for signature on 1 July 1968 in London, Moscow and Washington, and the UK, USSR, USA and over fifty other states signed that day. It took effect on 5 March 1970 and was extended indefinitely on 11 May 1995; 191 states have joined.

uncertainty.note: Start is opening for signature (1 July 1968); end is entry into force (5 March 1970). The treaty remains in force.
